clauses: This distinguished chemist received numerous prestigious accolades for their work, including the Willard Gibbs Award, the ACS Award in Pure Chemistry, the National Medal of Science, the NAS Award in Chemical Sciences, the Arthur C.
Cope Award, and the Welch Award in Chemistry.
They were also elected as a Foreign Member of the Royal Society.
Despite their highly decorated career and significant contributions to the field of chemistry, this individual was never awarded the Priestley Medal.
